geographyNote: City of Delta, British Columbia (census subdivision)

facts.text: Annacis Island and Tilbury provide over 3,450 acres of industrial land in Delta, home to over 700 businesses and over 18,000 jobs.
facts.evidence: Combined, Annacis and Tilbury provide over 3,450 acres of industrial land, home to over 700 businesses providing over 18,000 good paying jobs.

facts.text: Delta's Deltaport terminal is Canada's largest container shipping port.
facts.evidence: Deltaport terminal is Canada's largest container shipping port, and the industrial lands at Tilbury and Annacis Island are two of the largest industrial areas in Metro Vancouver.

facts.text: The federally approved $3.5-billion Roberts Bank Terminal 2 project adds a three-berth container terminal at Roberts Bank in Delta.
facts.evidence: The federal government approved the Port of Vancouver's proposed $3.5-billion container terminal... a three-berth marine container terminal located at Roberts Bank in Delta, British Columbia

facts.text: Delta's farms, nurseries and greenhouses earn about $170 million in gross farm receipts annually.
facts.evidence: Agriculture still dominates much of the landscape, with the municipality's farms, nurseries and greenhouses producing fresh potatoes, field vegetables and berries, earning about $170 million in gross farm receipts annually.

meta.descriptor: a port and farming city of three communities south of Vancouver
meta.fact: home to Deltaport, Canada's largest container shipping port

overview: Delta counted 108,455 residents in the 2021 Census, up 6.1 percent from 102,238 in 2016. The median household income was $108,000 in 2020, and 38,058 occupied dwellings are spread across 179.66 square kilometres of suburbs, farmland and industrial land.

The port, the Tilbury and Annacis industrial areas and a large farm sector give Delta a strong job base. For a local business, the challenge is that Ladner, Tsawwassen and North Delta function like separate towns, each with its own shopping habits and competitors.

byService.seo: Searchers rarely type Delta alone, so SEO pages should target each community by name and compete with nearby Surrey and Richmond businesses for local queries.
byService.website-development: Industrial buyers at Tilbury and busy commuting families both research online first, so Delta websites need clear service areas, quick quote forms and fast mobile pages.
byService.branding: With about 108,000 residents spread across distinct communities, Delta branding should feel neighbourly and rooted in place, signalling which part of the city a business truly serves.
